product_overview: LenTrust is a peer-to-peer lending accountability app designed to facilitate lending and borrowing money with digital contracts, automatic repayment reminders, and a Trust Score system called Reliability Stars based on repayment history.
core_goals: Enable borrowers to create loan contracts with clear terms and validation.
Provide lenders with tools to review, accept, reject, or counter loan requests effectively.
Maintain a transparent contract lifecycle from request to settlement.
Track and manage repayment proofs, extension requests, and settlements accurately.
Calculate and display borrower Reliability Stars to reflect repayment behaviors.
Ensure privacy of sensitive data like Reliability scores, visible only to lenders.
Deliver a mobile-first, user-friendly Progressive Web App experience.
Persist user and contract data locally with offline-first support.
key_features: Contract creation form with validation including amount, due date, lender phone, and reason.
Dashboard summarizing loan requests, extensions, active contracts, borrower/lender actions, and payment proof management.
Detailed contract views supporting accept/reject, extension requests, settle up workflows, and proof viewing.
Tabbed contract list filtering all, active, and settled contracts with reusable UI components.
User profiles and search functionality with user switching capabilities.
Payment proof upload, viewing, and validation system with image preview dialogs.
Contract status management including extensions capped at 3 and final extension banner display.
Review and rating system for borrowers with pinned negative reviews and reliability calculations.
SPA routing covering all major pages like dashboard, contracts, profiles, analytics, settings, and help.
PWA features including manifest, service worker, and mobile-first design for app-like experience.
Zustand store managing authentication and current user state.
LocalStorage-backed mock data client supporting CRUD operations for contracts, users, reviews, and reminders.
user_flow_summary: Borrower creates a loan contract by entering amount, due date/time (48h to 90 days), lender phone, and optional reason; contract status set to REQUESTED.
Lender views incoming loan requests with borrower Reliability Stars and reviews; lender can accept, reject, or counter-offer.
Borrower monitors active and due contracts, can request up to 3 extensions; after 3 extensions, a final extension banner is displayed.
Borrower uploads payment proof to initiate settlement; contract marked as SETTLE_PENDING.
Lender reviews extension requests and settlement proofs; lender approves or denies them accordingly.
Upon repayment or after extension expiry, lender posts review that affects borrower's Reliability Stars.
Reliability Stars are calculated using repayment timeliness and resolution metrics and shown only to lenders.
Contract status flows through REQUESTED, ACTIVE, DUE, SETTLE_PENDING, SETTLED, and REJECTED lifecycles.
Validation prevents contracts with amounts under Rs.100, due dates outside allowed range, and invalid lender phone formats.
User can navigate through dashboard, profiles, search, analytics, and settings with smooth SPA routing.
validation_criteria: Contracts cannot be created with amount less than Rs. 100.
Due date must be at least 48 hours and no more than 90 days from contract creation.
Lender phone number must adhere to the Indian format prefixed with +91.
Only one active loan request allowed per borrower-lender pair at a time.
Extension requests capped at a maximum of 3 per contract; display final extension banner after third extension.
Reliability rating calculations must update correctly after repayments and reviews.
Negative reviews remain pinned until borrower resolves the outstanding dues.
All UI validation errors for amount, due date, and phone format must show accurate messages.
Data persistence and retrieval must work reliably via LocalStorage.
Role-based visibility controls implemented, such as Reliability score visible only to lenders in the request context.
